cases.name: pagination_off_by_one
cases.title: Pagination skips the first page
cases.diagnosis: The pagination start index is calculated as page * size, causing the first page to skip items and the last page to be empty; it should offset by one page.
cases.diff:
--- a/pagination.py
+++ b/pagination.py
@@ -22,6 +22,6 @@
         raise ValueError("page starts at 1")
     if size < 1:
         raise ValueError("size must be positive")
-    start = page * size
+    start = (page - 1) * size
     end = start + size
     return Page(items=items[start:end], page=page, size=size, total=len(items))

cases.name: tax_rate_units
cases.title: Tax computed with percentage instead of fraction (cross-file)
cases.diagnosis: tax_amount multiplies by the GST percentage directly instead of converting it to a decimal, causing tax values to be 100x too large.
cases.diff:
--- a/checkout.py
+++ b/checkout.py
@@ -2,7 +2,7 @@
 
 
 def tax_amount(price, category="standard"):
-    return round(price * rate_for(category), 2)
+    return round(price * rate_for(category) / 100, 2)
 
 
 def price_with_tax(price, category="standard"):
